about: §35, revised 2026-11-14 (owner: a test build creates and signs in exactly as the store app does): the relying party a build's passkeys live under, one rule (service_defaults::relying_party_id for native builds, web_relying_party_id for the web wallet), replayed by every shell. A release build, and a test build on a device, use getvela.app; whether a build may actually use it is getvela.app's association files' answer (iOS: the team's app id; Android: the release certificate only). A test build on a simulator or emulator, and the web dev server, use localhost. A device test build may name a domain of its own (TEST_RP_DOMAIN), which must be a bare host name. An ask that cannot be read has no relying party. A release build never reads the test domain.
